Bidirectional overlay on legacy_desktop DAU: the historical rise is subtracted from modern_windows training rows before mozaic (allocated across countries by trailing 28d modern_windows DAU share), then the same curve is added back to the per-country forecast. Curve shape: zero before the 2026-05-08 rollout; rises with the measured holdback-experiment excess (FF152-excluded, interpolated 7d trailing MA) through the last clean day 2026-06-23, where it reads 130,296; then a linear ramp at 2,714/day (the recorded ~19,000/wk rise at the cutoff) reaching the ceiling and flat through 2027-12-31. All three land before the 2026-07-27 training end. MEASURED/EXTRAPOLATED BOUNDARY: everything after 2026-06-23 is extrapolation by construction — contamination begins 2026-06-24 when the holdback control received the feature, so the counterfactual is permanently gone and no fresh telemetry can ever adjudicate between the three ceilings. CONSERVATISM: the measured effect had not plateaued at the cutoff and is held flat anyway; an independent convolution model of the same effect lands near 220,000/day, so 200,000 is a ~20K/day haircut — the smallest of the three, i.e. this is the LEAST conservative variant.
